title: EPHESIANS
SIX : TEN
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: ancient stone watchtower sunrise mountain mist
golden light rays piercing through heavy storm clouds
peaceful river flowing through rugged mountain valley
dramatic cliffside fortress overlook at sunset light
tall pine forest bathed in soft morning fog
solid granite mountain peaks standing firm in the sky
calm serene highland lake reflecting evening clouds

scenes.a: If that unseen opposition in your workplace is testing your resolve today, stay and take refuge.
Father, we come before Your throne seeking the mighty covering of Your spiritual armor right now.
Your holy word commands us saying, Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Grant us the steadfast courage to stand firm when discouragement tries to undermine our faith.
We heed Your instruction to Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Surround our minds with truth and guard our hearts with righteousness throughout every hour ahead.
In Jesus name we pray, Amen.
